question: Which form of the goddess should be visualized during this practice?
premises: Meditation on the goddess is prescribed.
The goddess is identified as Ucchiṣṭamātaṅgī.
She is described as the sole enchantress of the world.
inference: The practitioner should meditate on Ucchiṣṭamātaṅgī as the sole enchantress of the world.
plain_english: One should meditate on the goddess Ucchiṣṭamātaṅgī, the sole enchantress of the world.
